title: nys-feedback
description: A feedback prompt for the end of an experience, built with Lit and NYSDS tokens.

presets.title: Confirmation page and event log
presets.description: nys-feedback animates in on a license renewal confirmation page. A session cookie allows one answer until you clear it.
presets.notes: The feedback sits where the confirmation page had a divider. It waits two seconds, then slides in. Choose Good or Needs improvement: the panel animates to the thank-you message, and the log shows the event, then the cookie. Reload the preview: a finished form shows right away, with no entrance. Clear cookie brings the buttons back in place, and Replay entrance shows the entrance again.

presets.title: Layouts
presets.description: The component follows its container: one row when wide, one centered column when narrow.
presets.notes: The layout uses a container query, so it adapts inside a sidebar as well as on a phone.
presets.html:
Wide container

At 40rem and wider, the prompt and buttons share one row.

Narrow container

Below 40rem, everything stacks in one centered column.

After someone answers

The submitted attribute shows the thank-you message.
